text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Spring! That means cherry blossoms!
And droits!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In other words! The one who is the most exemplary this spring is none other than myself!
Sakura Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So with that said! Come with this super exemplary Class Rep!
Let's participate in the Droite-Gauche!!!!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Umm... Sorry, Class Rep!
My schedule's a bit tight this year...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see!
Well then, see you next year!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Won't you join me in the droite?!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? With Bakushin O-senpai!?
Th-That's far too great an honor...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Right now's your chance!
You can take this Super Class Rep out on a "date"!

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... I'm sorry!
A "date" with someone I basically just met is a little...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: NOOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Why...?! Why, everyone?!
Why must you turn down an invitation from your class representative?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ha!
Could it be... that I...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: —They don't trust me!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ooooooh! Please wait!
Please hold on, Bakushin O-san!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I-I believe! The reason you are being turned down is not because you aren't trusted...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Huh! Is that true!?
Then why... !?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Deduction: ...It is likely because a "date" is considered something special.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: A special someone...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
R-Rice thinks so too.
For example...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Like having an "idol" you just can't help but want to chase after...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Irreplaceable "companions" who have supported each other through thick and thin all along...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Granting peerless exhilaration to the subject."
I deduce that this is the condition for a "date."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"‘Bestows peerless elation’...
I see..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: —In short! What in the world does that mean!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I see! So 'unparalleled exhilaration' simply means a 'special thrill'!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That's right! As expected of you, Bakushin O-san!
Bravo! Flawless dictionary handling!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Ability enhancement confirmed. Search speed
has increased by 2% compared to previous usage.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... That's amazing, Bakushin O-san!
You've gotten faster at looking things up in the dictionary too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Right? Exactly!
I am the class representative, after all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: However! Now it all makes sense! The reason I couldn't be a "date" was...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: —Because you lacked Bakushin power!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You're saying I don't have enough speed
to be a "date" for everyone! That's what you mean, right!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"In that case! To make this an exemplary date!
All that's left now is to BAKUSHIN!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah! Please wait, Bakushin O-san!
You can't take the dictionary with you—!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Whew!
New personal best! Sasuga me!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So, how about it?! Haven't we become
an exemplary "date" by now!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Lately, people have been asking me about 'this' at every opportunity.
I don't know what happened, but for now—"
choice_data_list: This year's drawing is already over, y'know?
This year's drawing is already over, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Lately, people have been asking me about 'this' at every opportunity.
I don't know what happened, but for now—"
choice_data_list: This year's drawing is already over, y'know?
This year's drawing is already over, you know?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I see! Not yet, then!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If we're gonna Bakushin, we gotta do it Bakushin-style!
That's what you mean, right?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Please wait for me, everyone!
I shall deliver an exemplary class rep date! Without fail!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Still not enough!?
Even this isn't good enough!?"
choice_data_list: It's a little above average right now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I see! Then let us aim for the very top of the top! All that's left is to Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
choice_data_list: Why not just enter next year?
Why not just enter next year?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the Class Rep's Trainer!
What a wonderful idea!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then charging forward into next year!
Bakushin, bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A-And I'm supposed to be an exemplary class rep!
How could I let a school event completely slip my mind!?
choice_data_list: Working hard toward next year—how exemplary!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I did my best to encourage and cheer up
Sakura Bakushin O, who was on the verge of feeling down.
